response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong technical leadership, infrastructure expertise, and mentoring capabilities, he does not meet the minimum qualifications for this role. Most critically, he lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming experience, with only approximately 6 months documented at National Instruments (2014-2015). Although his expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps practices is valuable, the role requires deep systems-level programming skills in C++ that are essential for leading a cloud compute platform.
strengths: Extensive infrastructure and distributed systems experience, including microservices handling millions of requests/second and high-performance, low-latency applications at Dunnhumby
Proven technical leadership demonstrated through multiple senior/staff engineer roles, open-source project ownership, and creation of technical workshops and conference talks
Broad technical versatility across multiple programming languages and domains (web, mobile, embedded, cloud) with demonstrated ability to select appropriate tools for technical challenges
concerns: Critical gap in required C++ expertise: only ~6 months documented C++ experience versus the required 8 years minimum qualification
Recent career trajectory focused on full-stack product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js, AWS CDK) rather than systems-level or cloud compute platform development
Limited explicit evidence of deep technical mentoring within engineering teams; mentoring experience primarily through workshops and teaching rather than direct team leadership roles
